purpose: Deterministic, repo-native Platform vNext regression baseline (Issue #53). Groups are first-class and reference existing authoritative pytest modules/commands; no test logic is duplicated. Manifest groups are either pytest groups (type 'pytest' -> `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider`) or explicit repo-native command groups (type 'command', run from the repo root). The default invocation `python .ai-harness/regression/run_vnext_baseline.py` runs the COMPLETE required baseline, including the compile/static/preflight/changed-file harness checks, and exits non-zero if any required group fails. The top-level `gate` context (task_contract / changed_files_base) is the single reusable parameter seam so the SAME entrypoint runs the current authorized gate (G9 here) without hard-coding a gate.

static_checks.note: This repository configures no ruff/mypy/black/pyright/flake8 static/lint/type tool (pyproject.toml has only [tool.setuptools.*] and [tool.pytest.ini_options]). The G8 baseline does not invent one; the checks_static_lint_type command group verifies absence truthfully and fails if a configured static tool appears without baseline execution.
